column1: # The shipped film samples, for `install_samples` in ../aliases and for
# test/findcrops. Tab separated, one row per scan:
# Every scan is copied whole into ~/.config/dither/samples/<film>/, where
# --mask-sample <film> pools them for dft, markov and inpaint. The window
# columns are filled on exactly one row per film: that scan's window is cut
# `search` says which of findcrops' searches chose it, and `#N` that it is
# that search's Nth window, picked by eye from its --top list; the README says why.
